eviction_behavior.rule: LRU eviction — least recently used model evicted when MAX exceeded
eviction_behavior.test_1: Load qwen3.8 as 3rd → evicted gpt-oss-20b + qwen3.5 (both had requests), kept qwen3.6 + loaded qwen3.8
eviction_behavior.test_2: Retry load qwen3.8 → evicted gpt-oss-20b, kept qwen3.6 + qwen3.8

max_concurrent_models.notes: Router strictly enforces LLAMA_ARG_MODELS_MAX=2; 3rd load evicts LRU model(s)

concurrency_impact.summary: Both models lose ~30-40% throughput when running concurrently
concurrency_impact.cause: Shared GPU memory bandwidth and compute on single Radeon 8060S
